title: Four-milestone course essay process
authority_note: Use only after binding and reading the controlling assignment. The assignment and current user instruction remain higher authority.

M1.name: Short project memo
M1.function: Explore and communicate the preliminary focus before the argument is fixed.
required_elements: what draws the author to the topic

M2.name: Annotated references
M2.function: Build the source base and explain what each source contributes to the developing inquiry.
required_elements: a brief contribution annotation for each source

M3.name: Structured outline
M3.function: Design the final paper's argument before full drafting.
required_elements: how the tension illuminates the domain
how the application sharpens the originating idea

M4.name: Complete paper draft for feedback
M4.function: Present the full argument at feedback-ready depth while allowing claims and wording to remain provisional.

FINAL.name: Final paper
FINAL.function: Elaborate and revise the full argument after the milestone sequence and feedback stage.
required_elements: situated course idea, concept, or moment
reciprocal sharpening of idea and application
